description: This file defines the AnalysisOrchestratorService class, which coordinates the analysis pipeline for resumes, including ATS checks, skills extraction, suggestions, and job recommendations within a backend service. It uses dependency injections, async operations, and integrates various repositories and services to perform comprehensive analysis tasks.

classes.name: AnalysisOrchestratorService
classes.description: Coordinates and executes the end-to-end resume analysis pipeline, managing ATS checks, skill extraction, suggestion generation, and job recommendation creation.

methods.name: None _run_analysis_pipeline( self, analysis_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, text: Optional[str] = None, resume_id: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Performs the core analysis steps including ATS evaluation, skill extraction, and suggestions, updating analysis status accordingly.

methods.name: UUID start_analysis_for_resume( self, user_id: UUID, resume_id: int, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks )
methods.description: Creates an analysis record for a resume and schedules the analysis pipeline to run in the background.

methods.name: UUID analyze_text(self, user_id: UUID, text: Optional[str], target_role: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates an analysis record for given text, runs the analysis synchronously, and stores results.

methods.name: None _create_recommendations(self, analysis_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, candidate_skills: List[str])
methods.description: Generates job recommendations based on candidate skills and user preferences by scoring and filtering recent job postings.
